proofScope.reported: debounce(fn, 100, { leading: true, trailing: true }); one click expects ["click"], not ["click", "click"].
proofScope.covers: Leading plus trailing runs once per isolated burst and trails only when a burst contains another call.
cases: Single call: invokes immediately and remains at one invocation after 100 ms.
Two calls 50 ms apart: invokes first immediately and last 100 ms after the second.
Two isolated calls 100 ms apart: each burst invokes exactly once.

proofScope.covers: Los resultados conservan el orden de entrada sin importar el orden de finalización ni el límite de concurrencia.
cases: Dos tareas concurrentes terminan en orden inverso y sus resultados mantienen el orden de entrada.
Una tarea en cola termina antes que una tarea de entrada anterior y los resultados mantienen el orden de entrada.
Con un solo worker, los resultados mantienen el orden de entrada.

proofScope.covers: runPool returns each task result at its input index regardless of completion order or concurrency limit.

With limit 1, results remain in input order.

proofScope.covers: Wrap width counts grapheme clusters, including modifier, combining-mark, and ZWJ sequences.
cases: Three skin-tone emojis and two spaces exactly fit width 5.
At width 4, three skin-tone emojis wrap as two emojis then one.
Decomposed accented graphemes and a space exactly fit width 3.
A family ZWJ emoji counts as one character when wrapping adjacent words.
A long emoji word splits by grapheme clusters at the width boundary.

proofScope.covers: Los meses cortos usan su último día y los siguientes recuperan el día mensual original.

proofScope.reported: After profileTitle(1) returns "Ana (admin)", renaming Ana to Bea must make it return "Bea (admin)", not "Ana (admin)".
proofScope.covers: profileTitle always reflects current user data, including updates after prior reads and creation after a missing lookup.
cases: Reported rename: after Ana is renamed to Bea, the title changes from "Ana (admin)" to "Bea (admin)".
Role update: after admin changes to editor, the title changes from "Bea (admin)" to "Bea (editor)".
Missing then created: after "Unknown user", saving Carlos/viewer makes the title return "Carlos (viewer)".
